visual_direction_gate.reason: Two canonical visual references plus an accepted Silver Coin visual source library already establish the direction.

approach.name: Living Pre-Raphaelite Source-Canon Rebuild
approach.story_form: A continuous cold-road-to-warm-tavern folk world centered on the recurring blonde flower-crowned woman, silver coin motif, working people, musicians, and communal release.
approach.source_strategy: Use the eight accepted V8 hero paintings as primary visual anchors; reuse source/reference pixels only with provenance; create additional alternate coverage only when the locked storyboard requires it.
approach.motion_strategy: Internal scene motion first. Verse/intimate shots stay near the restrained reference-B envelope; chorus/fiddle/dance passages may rise toward reference-A activity while protecting faces, hands, instruments, clothing, and topology.
approach.spatial_strategy: Bounded 2.5D depth/parallax and layered compositing. Do not claim NeRF unless an actual trained field and proof are produced.
approach.fx_strategy: Motivated firelight, smoke, rain, coin glints, cloth/hair movement, crowd micro-motion, reflections, fog/pigment travel, light shafts, and audio-reactive accents using current canonical FX/workflows.
approach.transition_strategy: Silver coin/reflection, smoke, rain, candle bloom, door/threshold and pigment-temperature transitions; avoid random morph demonstrations.
